        int maxSeq = 0;
        int parenCount = 0;
        int i = 0;
        boolean inParens = false;
        
        while (i < input.length) {
            char c = input[i];
            if (c == '(') {
                inParens = true;
                i++;

                i++;

                        i++;
                    }
                    parenCount++;
                } else {
                    int start = i;

                        i++;
                    }

                }
            } else {
                i++;
            }
        }
